newsitem.title: POLAND: PBR plans up to 8.4-million-share issue.
newsitem.headline: PBR plans up to 8.4-million-share issue.

text.p: The Polish Development Bank (PBR) plans a new share issue of between one and 8.4 million shares ex-rights which would be offered in an open and a closed tranche, the bank said in a statement on Tuesday.
PBR said it wanted to offer shares in the closed tranche to financial institutional investors, but said sizes of the tranches would be set later.
The issue has yet to be approved by PBR's general shareholders meeting on February 28.
It was not immediately clear whether the issue was connected with the creating of a bank-insurance group, that PBR earlier said it could join.
The bank's officials were not immediately available for comment.
The group was likely to further include Bank Przemyslowo Handlowy (BPH), Kredyt Bank, state-owned Powszechny Bank Kredytowy (PBK) and Warta.
